_comment: Robinhood Chain mainnet. Every external address is real and comes from docs/SPEC.md 1.4 and 1.5 (cast-verified 2026-09-02), so no mock is deployed on this chain; a zero here is what tells the deploy a mock is needed, and there are none. The four governance addresses are deliberately left at zero: script/Config.sol refuses to run on 4663 while any of them is zero, so a mainnet deploy cannot start until a human has filled in the Ledger EOA, the two guardian keys, the treasury and the keeper. See docs/RUNBOOK.md.
label: robinhood-mainnet

governance._comment: SPEC 15 / D-003: TimelockController(48 h, proposers = [adminEOA], executors = [adminEOA], admin = address(0) so it self-administers). The admin EOA is a hardware wallet; no multisig, by decision. Two guardian holders per D-012 as amended by D-029: a hot key on the keeper server, distinct from the keeper transaction key, and an off-server key held by the founder. cancellers is empty and stays empty until OQ-001 is decided; a canceller must never be a guardian key.

external._comment: USDG and the USDG/USD feed are the real Paxos and Chainlink addresses (SPEC 1.4, 1.5). sequencerFeed is zero because no L2 uptime feed is published for this chain (D-005); the storage slot and the check stay so the timelock can enable it later. priceSourcePlaceholder is only ever the constructor argument of AuctionHouse and CapController, both re-pointed at the SettlementOracle in timelock batch A.

vaults._comment: NVDA only at launch. SPEC 1.5 records that the SPY/USDG and QQQ/USDG 0.05 % pools exist, but their depth against the 250 000 USDG / 1 % rule of SPEC 9.3 was never measured, and OQ-002 blocks creating those vaults until it is. Adding one is a new entry here plus a re-run: AuctionHouse.registerVault and SettlementOracle.registerVault are per-vault and the earlier vaults are untouched.
vaults.name: Overwrite NVDA

mock._comment: Unused on 4663: a mock is deployed only where the address above is zero.

oracleParams._comment: The SPEC 9 defaults, identical to RiskModule.defaultParams(). Deploy emits a setOracleParams call only for the vaults whose block differs from that default, so batch A stays as short as it can be. OQ-002 note: usdgMaxStale of 26 h will frequently fail on a Sunday, since the USDG/USD feed follows the same 24/5 schedule as the stock feeds; raising it here to 288000 (80 h) is the recorded alternative to accepting path 3 as the de-facto weekend primary.

token._comment: Set deploy to false to ship the vault layer alone and run the token layer later through script/DeployToken.s.sol, which uses the same TokenDeployLib. With deploy true the token layer rides the same four stages.
